last.verdict: Record sales came from Alani Nu, but the flagship CELSIUS brand shrank again and margins fell sharply, so profit is not keeping pace.

takeaways.label: Margins keep sliding
takeaways.text: Gross margin fell to 46.8% from 51.3% a year ago, on higher aluminum and fuel costs and more sales through PepsiCo's delivery system. Adjusted EBITDA slipped 3% despite 17% revenue growth.

takeaways.label: Flagship still shrinking
takeaways.text: CELSIUS brand revenue fell about 6% to $356.8M, and its retail sales fell 7%. The company blamed fewer products, inventory timing and weak club-store sales.

takeaways.label: Alani Nu carries growth
takeaways.text: Alani Nu revenue rose 24% to $410.1M and its retail sales jumped 58%. It now holds a 9.8% U.S. energy drink share, slightly above CELSIUS at 9.1%.

takeaways.label: Leadership reshuffle
takeaways.text: Celsius created brand-led management, naming Alex Zigliara to run CELSIUS and Rishi Daing to run Rockstar and emerging brands. International sales rose 78% to $41.0M.

history.verdict: Big revenue and profit miss, with the flagship CELSIUS brand shrinking again.

reasons.label: Flagship brand shrinking
reasons.text: CELSIUS brand sales fell about 12%; management admitted cutting too many products.

reasons.label: Missed estimates
reasons.text: Revenue of $818M trailed the roughly $870M expected; adjusted EPS $0.36 vs $0.42.

reasons.label: Margins stay squeezed
reasons.text: Gross margin was 48.1% vs 51.5% a year ago; aluminum costs and promotions weighed.
